newsitem.title: USA: D&P downgrades Whirlpool senior debt.
newsitem.headline: D&P downgrades Whirlpool senior debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it downgraded the senior debt of Whirlpool Corp to single-A-minus from single-A and its commercial paper rating to D-one-minus from D-one.
About $2.4 billion of debt is affected.

The rating downgrade reflects the overall weakening of credit protection measures resulting from persistently weak earnings in key markets combined with heavy investments to establish businesses in new Asian markets, D&P said in a statement. Over the last two years, corporate earnings and cash flow have been significantly impacted by costs and pricing pressures particularly in Europe, and by operating losses from start-up businesses in Asia, it said.
During this time, debt levels have increased to support the strategic expansion into high-growth markets in Asia and to implement corporate restructuring programs, it said.

Earnings and cash flow should strengthen in 1997 based primarily on a better operating cost structure. Improvement to interest coverage and cash flow leverage measures should follow. But the company is not expected to return to credit measures of previous years, D&P said. At expected earnings levels, the company has limited potential to reduce debt materially, the credit rating company said.

Competitive conditions in Europe remain intense and demand levels are expected to improve only modestly in the near term, D&P said. As a result, expected improvements in Whirlpool's earnings and debt protection measures depend on sustained results from strong North American operations and from restructuring benefits and operating improvements in Europe.

Demand levels in North America remain firm and earnings in 1997 should benefit from cost reduction programs and ramp-up of production at a new range facility. Losses in Asia are expected to be reduced in the near term, but the longer term outlook remains highly uncertain, it said.
Shares of Whirlpool were trading unchanged at 50-3/8.
